roles.heroLead: Ask for the assembly spec and we'll happily send it: bonded membrane, pre-sloped base, sealed penetrations, and a 24-hour flood test we photograph before tile goes on. In a Redmond shower, that documentation is the difference between twenty dry years and a five-figure framing repair.
roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Redmond, WA?
roles.costP1: For Redmond tile work the budget line reads $14 to $26 a square foot once set — tile, setting mortar, substrate prep and labor bundled, the labor entry starting from $11/sq ft. Standard tub-shower surrounds hold inside the $3,200–$6,800 bracket, while a bathroom done end to end — floor, shower, niche — closes out at $6,500–$14,000.
roles.costP2: Here's the variable most spreadsheets miss: format drives labor harder than material price does. A $4 mosaic sheet often costs more to set than large-format porcelain at $12, because the hours follow cuts and grout lines rather than the invoice.
roles.costNote: Figures hold for Redmond as of August 2026, bundling tile with materials and labor. Treat the written quote from the free estimate as the number of record.
roles.layersLead: Bottom to top, the assembly runs seven layers. When a Redmond shower fails, the post-mortem almost always finds one missing — usually the membrane, trimmed out to save a few hundred bucks on work that later costs five figures to reopen.
roles.whyP1: Leaks run silent for years. Moisture slips past grout, saturates the substrate, and only surfaces as a soft hallway floor or a ceiling stain on the level below. At that point you're paying for framing, subfloor, drywall and a complete re-tile.
roles.whyP2: Run the numbers: waterproofing is roughly 10% of a shower's cost, and deleting it is the most expensive line-item cut in remodeling.
roles.scopeIntro: Every price below is a starting point — format, substrate condition and layout complexity move it. Your exact figure is written on site, free.

roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Redmond, WA?
roles.faqA1: Redmond installs work out between $14 and $26 per square foot once set, with tile, setting materials, prep and labor all inside — labor entering the sheet at $11 per square foot. Surrounds for a standard tub-shower hold inside the $3,200–$6,800 bracket; a roughly 45 sq ft bathroom floor holds near $900–$1,600; and taking the bathroom end to end — floor, shower, niche — closes out at $6,500–$14,000. Watch format above all: mosaics and oversized planks each burn considerably more labor per installed foot than plain-grid 12×12.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Redmond?
roles.faqA2: A standard alcove shower in Redmond holds inside the $3,200–$6,800 bracket, with demolition, the bonded waterproofing spec, a pre-sloped pan, the tile, a niche and grout all accounted for. Steam, benches, curbless thresholds and stone run to the ceiling move the spec — and the price — upward. Waterproofing itself claims about a tenth of the budget, and that same tenth removes the five-figure failure mode from the table.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Always — and the spec sheet is yours for the asking. Each shower is built to ANSI A118.10 and TCNA guidance as a bonded membrane system: pre-sloped base, membrane climbing the walls, with seams, corners and penetrations all sealed, then a 24-hour flood test held and photographed before setting starts. Tile and grout merely delay water; the stopping is work the membrane performs alone.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Normal course for a Redmond bathroom is four to six working days, with demolition and dust control opening the job. Substrate and membrane work follow, the 24-hour flood test standing overnight; setting occupies another day or two; the last day goes to grout, silicone and trim. Hold off 24 hours after grouting for cure before anyone showers. On its own, a floor tends to finish inside two days.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Wherever water or foot traffic is involved, spec porcelain: the denser body chips less and holds absorption under 0.5%. Ceramic remains a sound, cheaper pick for walls and backsplashes. The default Redmond spec reads porcelain across every floor and shower floor, with ceramic and glass winning wall space when the design argues for them.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes — and Redmond being Redmond, the smart-thermostat request usually arrives with it; we wire those in gladly. Heated tile costs $11 to $16 for the installed square foot, thermostat counted. The mat rests on uncoupling membrane, gets its resistance verified both sides of the setting work, and claims a dedicated circuit. Decide early, though — the economics hold only while the floor is open.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: Nine jobs in ten, out it comes. Figure about $3.50 a square foot for tear-out with hauling, and treat demolition as the inspection it really is — the sole way to check the subfloor for rot or movement and keep finished height sane where doorways land. Going over existing tile occasionally works on a flat, sound, bonded surface, yet it stacks the floor higher and hides exactly what demo would have caught.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Redmond?
roles.faqA8: Backsplash math for Redmond: a standard run near 30 square feet prices between $1,100 and $2,200 installed — outlet cutting, edge trim and color-keyed grout inside the figure. What pushes an install toward the ceiling of the range is layout — herringbone, mosaic sheets, a framed panel over the range, slab-look porcelain floor to ceiling — since cutting time, not material, sets the labor.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Frequently. Repair and regrout opens its pricing at $8 per square foot and suits stained or failing grout, one or two tiles split by an impact, and shower corners overdue for silicone. It stops making sense once the substrate quits: tile that thuds hollow, pieces working loose in a pattern, any flex in the wall. That's replacement territory, and we say so plainly before a price is quoted.
roles.faqQ10: Which Redmond neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: All of Redmond is in range — Downtown, Education Hill, Grass Lawn, Overlake, Idylwood, Viewpoint, the Sammamish Valley, Bear Creek, North Redmond, English Hill, Willows/Rose Hill, Southeast Redmond and Marymoor Village, plus Redmond Ridge, Union Hill and Novelty Hill east of town. Kirkland, Bellevue, Sammamish, Woodinville and the rest of the Eastside are regular territory too.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: Workmanship on our tile carries a 2-year warranty — twice what carpet gets, since tile trouble prefers the second year to the second week. Choose a manufacturer's complete waterproofing assembly and the maker's system coverage stacks over ours. Every membrane and flood test is photographed too, so dated proof of what sits behind the tile is yours on the day you sell.
roles.hoodsOut: Missing your neighborhood? An hour's radius around Redmond is all workable — say where you are when booking.
